correctness.rationale: Plug-state normal form is exhaustive: only empty, adjacent-pair and full plugs are compatible with within-layer C4 matchings. Unique zero-plug block decomposition, exact block and junction flip counting, sharp block lower and upper inequalities and equality constraints rigorously prove all stated all-n bounds and multiplicities. Direct 3D perfect matching enumeration and independent 16-state weighted transfer produce identical full degree histograms for n=1..8, and transfer checks extrema through n=15; finite tests are corroboration, not substitutes for infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Targeted searches compared the thin-box 2014 primary study, subsequent twist and cylinder studies, equivalent perfect-matching/resonance terminology and accessible earlier local-configuration records. The same-box prior work establishes flip connectivity but not exact local flip-degree extrema, all maximizing tilings, the minimum-equality count for 3|n, or the full polynomial transfer. The conclusion is best-knowledge novelty, subject to residual unindexed sources.
residual_risks: Equivalent exact degree enumeration might appear in unindexed older combinatorics or mathematical physics literature.
A surface-graph identification with a different allowed move set can obscure apparently similar theorems.
Publication priority and any earlier private computational notes are not externally certified.

value.rationale: The number of immediately available elementary dimer flips is a natural local reconfiguration mobility statistic not determined by known connectivity. The exact extremal gap, full identity of maximum-degree states, exponentially numerous minimum-degree states at n divisible by 3, and 16-state enumeration of all degrees provide a complete motivated structural characterization for a canonical infinite thin-box family. No downstream mixing-rate theorem is claimed.
